revision_notes: Original 'No' was unsupported by any source. Evidence shows Mali is actively rolling out 'NINACAD-Adresse', a digital addressing system covering roughly 1.5 million parcels across Bamako District, Kati, Ségou, Koulikoro and Sikasso (presented to government March 2025; DGI update January 2026, further extension planned). Revised to 4 (Partially deployed) as coverage is substantial but confirmed not yet nationwide.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital population register?
Comments: No credible evidence found for a digital population register after searching population register, national population register digital, civil register of persons, recensement digital, ID4D dataset, Ministry of Interior, e-gov portals.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original 'No' is contradicted by substantial evidence: Mali has operated a biometric population register (RAVEC) since 2009 under Law No. 06-040/2006, with 14.5 million of 15.2 million Malians enrolled and issued NINA numbers (Ministry of Territorial Administration, via Bamada.net), and Malian authorities restored sovereign control of the database as 'Mali Kura Biométrie' in February 2024 after a data-access dispute with vendor Idemia. Revised to 5 (Fully deployed nationwide) given near-universal enrolment and its use across ID, electoral and civil-status services.
